# Official ICML 2026 author style

These files are unmodified extractions from the official author archive:
[icml2026.zip](https://media.icml.cc/Conferences/ICML2026/Styles/icml2026.zip),
linked by the [ICML author instructions](https://icml.cc/Conferences/2026/AuthorInstructions).
Retrieved on 2026-11-13. Preserve the original copyright notices in the files.

The manuscript uses the supported `preprint` option. It does not use `accepted`
or claim an ICML publication. A local notice-only author footer replaces the
template's affiliation/contact block because those details were not provided.
No page geometry, font size, or spacing is modified.
